title: Alerts page and risk center show no alerts when the alert read timed out
hosted_verification_note: Hosted verification was not run. Per the task brief, hosted verification is deferred to the operator acceptance task MGMT-AI-TRUTH-ACCEPTANCE-20261107; only local functional and typecheck verification was executed.

acceptance_criteria.1_alerts_page_unavailable_not_empty_and_: verified: loadListItems in src/management/pages/Operations.tsx calls assertAlertsNotTimeoutFallback(envelope) (keyed on meta.surfaces.alerts.source === 'timeout_fallback' across read_timeout, read_saturated, and read_error), causing TanStack Query to record an error state without overwriting cached rows. AlertsPage renders <Card role='alert'> with t('page.alertsUnavailable') and hides the empty table when no cached rows exist, while keeping previously cached rows visible if a subsequent refresh returns timeout_fallback.
acceptance_criteria.2_risk_center_alert_table_error_state_an: verified: listAlerts() in src/lib/bff-v1/operations.ts reads the raw /bff/alerts body via strictLiveRead and calls assertAlertsNotTimeoutFallback(body) outside strictLiveRead. RiskCenter's loadSlice catches the rejection for the alerts slice and renders tableEmptyForSlice(alertsSlice, t('empty.noAlerts'), t) -> t('status.unavailable') while strategies, personas, capitalPools, runtimes, and incidents slices continue rendering.
acceptance_criteria.3_healthy_zero_alerts_empty_state_and_de: verified: Healthy empty responses (meta.surfaces.alerts.source === 'bff_composed', status: 'ok', alerts: []) resolve to [] and render t('page.alertsEmpty') on AlertsPage and t('empty.noAlerts') on RiskCenter. Responses with meta.surfaces.alerts.source === 'bff_composed' and status: 'degraded' due to a contributing surface keep resolving and normalize real BFF alert rows (alert_id -> id, summary -> title, category -> source, raised_at -> openedAt, target_ref.target_id -> relatedTarget, acknowledged: false).
acceptance_criteria.4_global_live_status_not_switched_to_fal: verified: assertAlertsNotTimeoutFallback is invoked outside strictLiveRead in listAlerts() and in Operations.tsx loadListItems, so liveStatus.reportFallback is never called, liveStatus.get().effective remains 'live', and LiveStatusBanner renders no fallback or strict-error banner.
acceptance_criteria.5_lists_alerts_resolves_for_topbar_and_n: verified: lists.alerts() continues resolving with ListEnvelope<Alert> (preserving meta) so TopBar's classifyListSource marks alerts degraded without failing. NotificationCenter isolates bffV1.alerts.list() with its own .catch(() => setAlerts([])) so approvals, jobs, and incidents still render when GET /bff/alerts falls back. StrategyDetail, IncidentDetail, and EvolutionDetail continue rendering.
acceptance_criteria.6_locale_strings_and_i18n_parity: verified: page.alertsEmpty and page.alertsUnavailable exist in both src/i18n/locales/en-US.ts and src/i18n/locales/zh-TW.ts, and src/lib/v5/management/__tests__/i18nParity.test.ts passes (11/11 tests).
acceptance_criteria.7_typecheck_and_affected_tests_pass_and_: verified: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit, tsc -p tsconfig.agora.json --noEmit, tsc --noEmit, and all 5 affected test files pass; hosted verification was not run.
